interface.shortDescription: REEL films and ONCE life stories
interface.longDescription: PlotPickle Studio is an on-demand, ChatGPT-native creative production system with two paths: REEL for movies and ONCE for life stories. The approved Skin V1 design system (v0.8.38) makes HOME, Storyboard, Story Map, Mini-Block/25-shot grid and source-backed Image Review use consistent layouts and evidence presentation. Skin V1 is a packaged design/template contract rendered in normal ChatGPT replies; it is not a separately hosted persistent graphical app or a guarantee of pixel-identical rendering on every ChatGPT host. The Save/Lock transaction interaction design is approved, while real writes still require secure current source/bytes, version guards, validation and independent readback. Existing PPF screenplay reader, 81 lessons, Character and World Builders, Layout Sheets, Assets, Posters, Reports, Pitch Decks, animatic, editing, Sound, Suno, fal motion and BUZZ/Modem plans remain available. Provider costs require individual prior approval; no status, media or persistence is invented. No mandatory Windows app, GitHub account or sidebar. Production Handoff Skin V1 layout and other unreviewed surfaces are not yet approved. This release adds the approved REEL starting workspace (New Idea, Import Script, Continue Film, Explore Tools), a stacked mobile Storyboard Review that adapts the creator’s older three-column reference, and optional five-page/25-panel graphic-novel reading for each Mini-Block. The design remains dynamically rendered inside ChatGPT and does not install a hosted sidebar. Actual graphic-novel pages and PPF sources remain private in the creator’s Library; no project images are bundled. Other unapproved surfaces and unverified writes remain pending. Version 0.8.39 adds an owner-approved official-edition reading route for The Third Bell: the first Mini-Block in each of Blocks 01 and 02, ten sequential graphic-novel pages with five illustrated panels and captions per page. The approved artwork, original PDF, HTML reader and archive are loaded only from authorized private Library/Project files, not embedded in the plugin. Opening the edition never changes the PPF screenplay authority, image approval, Save/Lock or production status. It verifies available files and never invents media links.
